records.audience: 刚开始承接客户项目的平面设计师
records.task: 在约定范围内收集反馈、完成修改并收款

evidence.quote: it goes beyond what we agreed to and what the budget can handle.
payment is kept on hold till then.

solutions.name: 提前约定修改轮次
solutions.summary: 回复建议设定 2–3 轮上限，并约定超出部分的收费方式；未验证发帖者的使用结果
solutions.quote: Set revision limits upfront - 2-3 rounds max.

solutions.name: 把分散反馈合并为一轮
solutions.summary: 回复将一轮定义为一次汇总反馈后统一修改，减少零散追加；效果尚待回访
solutions.quote: Define what a "round" means (all feedback at once, you make changes once).

records.title: How do you handle extra revisions?
records.problem: 额外修改怎样计数、提醒与收费，现有流程容易含糊
records.audience: 按项目收费、需要管理客户修改的设计师
records.task: 区分已包含和额外的修改，让双方理解还剩多少轮

evidence.quote: How do you handle extra revisions? Do you charge for more revisions?
For a long time feedback came in over chat, email and comments in a shared folder, a bit at a time, and "3 rounds" meant nothing

solutions.name: 统一收集一批反馈，并提示剩余轮次
solutions.summary: 回复者描述将一轮定义为集中收集的一批反馈，交付邮件中说明剩余轮次；属于个人经验
solutions.quote: Now a round is one batch of feedback, collected in one place and sent back together.
